## Migration Summary: Pages Router → App Router

### Removed
- `pages/` directory (entirely deleted)

### Created (all TypeScript with types)

| App Router File | Replaces | Key Changes |
|---|---|---|
| `app/layout.tsx` | `_app.js` + `_document.js` | Root layout with `<html>`/`<body>`, `next/font/google` for Inter (replaces Google Fonts `<link>`), `Metadata` export, global CSS import, nav/footer |
| `app/page.tsx` | `pages/index.js` | Async Server Component; `headers()` replaces `req.headers` from `getServerSideProps`; `cache: "no-store"` for dynamic fetch; `Metadata` export replaces `<Head>` |
| `app/view-all-posts-button.tsx` | (inline in index.js) | Extracted `"use client"` component for `useRouter().push()` |
| `app/blog/page.tsx` | `pages/blog/index.js` | Async Server Component; `next: { revalidate: 60 }` replaces ISR from `getStaticProps` |
| `app/blog/read-more-button.tsx` | (inline in blog/index.js) | Extracted `"use client"` component |
| `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` | `pages/blog/[id].js` | `generateStaticParams` replaces `getStaticPaths`; `generateMetadata` replaces `<Head>`; `params` is `Promise` (awaited); `notFound()` replaces `{ notFound: true }` |
| `app/blog/[id]/back-button.tsx` | (inline in blog/[id].js) | Extracted `"use client"` component |
| `app/not-found.tsx` | `pages/404.js` | Server Component with `Link` (no `useRouter` needed); `Metadata` export |
| `app/error.tsx` | `pages/_error.js` | `"use client"` Error Boundary with `error`/`reset` props |
| `app/global-error.tsx` | (new) | Global error boundary with full `<html>`/`<body>` |
| `app/api/posts/route.ts` | `pages/api/posts/index.js` | Named `GET`/`POST` exports; `NextRequest`/`NextResponse`; typed request bodies |
| `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` | `pages/api/posts/[id].js` | Named `GET`/`PUT`/`DELETE` exports; `params` is `Promise` (awaited) |
| `components/AppProvider.tsx` | `components/AppProvider.js` | `"use client"` directive; full TypeScript types for context |

### Key API migrations
- `getServerSideProps` → async Server Component + `headers()`
- `getStaticProps` with `revalidate` → `fetch()` with `next: { revalidate }` option
- `getStaticPaths` → `generateStaticParams`
- `<Head>` → `export const metadata` / `generateMetadata`
- `next/router` → `next/navigation` (`useRouter` from `next/navigation`)
- `pages/api` handler → named HTTP method exports in `route.ts`
- `req`/`res` pattern → `NextRequest`/`NextResponse` (Web API standard)
